description: Monthly High Tide Outlook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS). This tool provides visualizations for when and where above-normal high tides and high tide flooding may be experienced, up to a year in advance. Coastal flooding likelihoods are derived from tide predictions, sea level rise trends, and seasonal changes in coastal sea level. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
